claims.statement: Tom Allen was advertised as the retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, 619 Market street, Free concert every evening

claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised a free concert every evening at 619 Market Street, with only the best singers engaged.
claims.excerpt: 619 Market street, Free concert every evening. Best of singers only engaged here.

notes: Advertisement only. The text calls 619 Market Street a free-concert place and does not say saloon; the kind follows the hint.
